title: Northern Virginia large-load delivery and local acceptance
question: Which named Northern Virginia projects progress from demand and authorization through built infrastructure, energization, compliant operation, and accepted local outcomes?
why_it_matters: Regional scale and forecasts do not establish whether the next customer can be served, whether infrastructure is built, or whether local environmental and community conditions are satisfied.
current_support: The local dossier now combines a legislative baseline, the 2026 PJM forecast, rate and transmission records, revised generator guidance, local standards, three named 2026 air permits, and water-service rails.
missing_evidence: customer-specific service agreements and disclosed load
final transmission routes, land rights, construction, and energization
facility-level permit, water, construction, and operation records
measured cost, reliability, emissions, noise, water, and community outcomes
candidate_records: Golden-Mars school-board land decision and final route record
GS-5 customer agreement or compliance filing
named data-center building and occupancy permits
named air-permit test and compliance reports
reclaimed-water allocation, connection, and metered use
next_action: Follow Golden-Mars, GS-5, Loudoun Phase 2, named DEQ permits, and provider records through final rules, construction, service, compliance, and measured outcomes.

named_records: Digital Third Second and Carver permit 74262-4
latest_review.stage_result: Eight additional records make forecast uncertainty, generator-control standards, a second transmission case, and three facility-level air-permit trails explicit. The missing proof remains final decisions, build, energization, customer service, testing, compliant operation, measured use, and outcomes.
latest_review.stop_rule: Do not treat a forecast, docket listing, policy project, permit, modeling requirement, or guidance document as approval, customer service, built infrastructure, compliant operation, or accepted local outcome.

notes: Phase 55X adds an eight-record implementation dossier and four bounded signals while preserving the October 1 Loudoun policy check.
